Validate

Source: R/validate.R
validate.Rd

Validate

Usage

validate(gt, module, compare = "table")

Arguments

gt

a data frame or vector of text

module

the module

compare

name of the module output table for comparison

Value

something

Examples

validate("p < .05", "stat_p_exact")
#>   paper_id    text text_id section_id paragraph_id formatted header
#> 1        1 p < .05       1          0            0   p < .05   Test
#>   section_type p_comp p_value expanded imprecise  zero
#> 1      unknown      <    0.05  p < .05      TRUE FALSE
